rca_of_the_issue: Root Cause: Binance fapi.binance.com endpoint returns HTTP 451 (Unavailable for Legal Reasons) for certain regions. Fix: Added fallback URL list in market_data_provider.py to try testnet.binancefuture.com when main endpoint fails. Additionally, symbol_selector_service.py now retries with force_refresh=True if initial API call returns empty rows.
